title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 Smart Compliance Rules
description: Fully configurable, dynamic rule definitions with versions, weights, priorities, sectoral categories, effective dates, and execution dependencies.

rules.description: Every package must bear the generic or common name of the commodity contained in the package on the principal display panel.
rules.failure_message: Mandatory generic or common product name is missing or cannot be identified on the package label.
rules.recommendation: Clearly print the common or generic name of the commodity on the Principal Display Panel (PDP) in accordance with Rule 6(1)(b).

rules.description: The name of the manufacturer, packer, or importer must be clearly declared on the package.
rules.failure_message: Manufacturer, packer, or importer business entity name is absent from the packaging declarations.
rules.recommendation: Declare the legal entity name of the manufacturer, pre-packer, or importer prominently on the label as per Rule 6(1)(a).

rules.description: Every package must declare the complete commercial or registered office address of the manufacturer, packer, or importer.
rules.failure_message: Complete postal address of the manufacturer, packer, or importer is missing or incomplete.
rules.recommendation: Provide the complete address including premise details, city, state, and postal code enabling postal communication under Rule 6(1)(a).

rules.description: Net quantity of the commodity contained in the package must be declared in terms of standard SI units of weight, measure, or number.
rules.failure_message: Net quantity declaration is missing, illegible, or not expressed in standard legal metrology units (g, kg, ml, L, m, or N/units).
rules.recommendation: Print net quantity in standard metric units (e.g., 'Net Qty: 500 g' or '1 L') complying with standard unit symbols in Rule 6(1)(c) and Rule 11.

rules.description: The maximum retail price inclusive of all taxes must be declared on the package in Indian Rupees (INR/₹).
rules.failure_message: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) declaration is missing or does not explicitly state 'inclusive of all taxes'.
rules.recommendation: Declare MRP explicitly in the format 'MRP Rs. / ₹ XX.XX (incl. of all taxes)' on the package in accordance with Rule 6(1)(da).

rules.rule_name: Month and Year of Manufacture / Packing / Import
rules.description: Every package must declare the month and year in which the commodity was manufactured, packed, or imported.
rules.failure_message: Month and year of manufacture, packing, or import is not declared or does not follow compliant MM/YYYY or Month YYYY formatting.
rules.recommendation: Clearly display the date of manufacture or packaging (e.g., 'Mfg Date: 04/2026' or 'Packed: Apr 2026') as mandated under Rule 6(1)(d).

rules.description: Every package must bear the name, address, telephone number, and email address of the person or office that can be contacted in case of consumer complaints.
rules.failure_message: Customer care / grievance redressal contact information (phone number, email, or contact address) is absent or incomplete.
rules.recommendation: Provide comprehensive customer care details including a reachable telephone/toll-free number, email address, and postal address for grievance redressal under Rule 6(1)(e).

rules.rule_name: Country of Origin for Imported Products
rules.description: For imported packages, the name of the country of origin or manufacture where the commodity was produced must be explicitly declared.
rules.failure_message: Country of origin declaration is missing on an imported packaged commodity.
rules.recommendation: Prominently declare the country of manufacture/origin (e.g., 'Country of Origin: Made in Germany' or 'Imported from Japan') on the package label as required by Rule 6(10) and Rule 6(1)(a).
rules.rule_reference: Rule 6(1)(a) & Rule 6(10), Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011

rules.description: For imported commodities, the name and complete physical address of the importer in India must be declared on the package.
rules.failure_message: Importer identity and registered address declaration is missing on the imported package.
rules.recommendation: Declare the registered legal name and complete postal address of the importer in India under Rule 6(1)(a).
rules.rule_reference: Rule 6(1)(a) & Rule 6(10), Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011

rules.description: Perishable items including food, beverage, cosmetics, and medicines must declare the Best Before, Expiry, or Use By date.
rules.failure_message: Best Before / Expiry Date declaration is missing or not legible on a perishable commodity.
rules.recommendation: Declare the expiry date clearly (e.g., 'Best Before: 24 Months from Mfg' or 'Expiry Date: 08/2027') as mandated under Legal Metrology and sectoral standards.
rules.rule_reference: Rule 6(1)(d) & Schedule II, Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011

rules.description: Electronic and electrical goods must declare their distinct model name/number, operating voltage, and wattage ratings on the packaging.
rules.failure_message: Model number or technical rating specifications are missing from the electronic package label.
rules.recommendation: Declare model designation and power ratings (e.g., 'Model: TX-500, Input: 220-240V ~ 50Hz, 65W') on the package PDP.
rules.rule_reference: Rule 6(1)(b) & Schedule II, Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
